analysis_contract.K16_status: descriptive pilot; no confirmatory claim at n=3
analysis_contract.K8_four_point_shape: require the 4-to-8 slope to exceed both the 2-to-4 pre-transition slope and the 8-to-16 saturation slope
analysis_contract.attention_reporting: hard-coded C=I dual attention is a same-target MxM-cost control; deployed learned attention targets G C G^T + lambda I, is not a same-H solver comparator, costs a dense MxM layer, and reports own-target iteration error separately from target bias
analysis_contract.claim_gate: no K/rank-transition conclusion from TRAINING_COMPLETE; a separately authenticated paired correct/wrong-context analysis is required
analysis_contract.coefficient_reference: H=G^T G+lambda I and rhs=G^T b exactly, with no hidden jitter, shared by final encoder attribution and classical replay
analysis_contract.error_decomposition: exact common-denominator encoder + solver + interaction identity
analysis_contract.failure_rule: withhold the entire confirmatory family if any required seed/cell or provenance gate fails
analysis_contract.solver_comparison: post-hoc Richardson, Heavy Ball, first-kind minimax Chebyshev, identity-preconditioner CG, and Jacobi-PCG replay on identical explicit H/rhs with one KxK H matvec per iteration; exact-spectrum oracle and preconditioner setup costs are labeled, with one shared replay spectrum but one standalone setup charged per spectral row
analysis_contract.task_pairing: nested training tasks; identical held-out tasks and separate named final-split/solver RNG streams within each paired seed
analysis_contract.threshold_kink: log(r_below)-2*log(r_at)+log(r_above); report effect and uncertainty, not merely a threshold label
